A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (4 April 2024). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Supplement of 30 May 2001.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ESB2P-L-lonerogue-PC-2024-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Lone Rogue (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (by 18 August 2019): Same words as the disc card. The whole card is drawn again at a larger size, with the mark “D-E1” in place of “the bronze disc”.

The whole disc card image and the whole D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
